<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 268.194, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 267.187 Da. The formula that best matches this mass with common organic elements (C, H, O) is C₁₆H₂₇O₃ (exact neutral mass 267.196 Da, giving [M+H]⁺ 268.203 Da, within experimental tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C16H27O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H27O3</final_answer>
